description: Every language in language_definitions.json must bundle a working tags.scm (vendored or query-overlays/<lang>/tags.scm) with a fixture under crates/ts-pack-core/tests/fixtures/tags/<lang>/, unless it is listed here with the reason tags do not apply. Enforced by crates/ts-pack-core/tests/tags_coverage.rs.

not_applicable.angular: Angular component templates; the component classes, inputs and methods are declared in the TypeScript file that owns the template
not_applicable.astro: HTML layer of an Astro component; its declarations live in the frontmatter and script blocks, which are injected TypeScript
not_applicable.cel: a single Common Expression Language expression evaluated by a host; no declarations
not_applicable.comment: parses TODO/FIXME/NOTE annotations inside comments of a host language; it has no declarations of its own
not_applicable.cooklang: recipe text whose @ingredients, #cookware and ~timers are inline mentions, not named declarations
not_applicable.cpon: Chainpack object notation: a JSON-like data serialization with no named definitions
not_applicable.cst: textual dump of a tree-sitter concrete syntax tree (node ranges and kinds); diagnostic output, not source
not_applicable.csv: comma-separated tabular data; rows and fields have no names to index
not_applicable.cypher: graph query statements; MATCH/CREATE clauses bind pattern variables for one query, not reusable declarations
not_applicable.d2: diagram description; its identifiers name shapes and connections to draw, not program symbols
not_applicable.diff: unified diff hunks; the changed lines belong to whatever language was diffed
not_applicable.dot: Graphviz graph description; node and subgraph ids are drawing data, not program symbols
not_applicable.doxygen: doc-comment markup injected into C/C++ comments; the documented symbols are tagged by the host language
not_applicable.editorconfig: section headers are file glob patterns such as [*.py] that select files, not named blocks
not_applicable.edoc: Erlang doc-comment markup; the documented functions are tagged by the Erlang grammar
not_applicable.eex: EEx template layer; all definitions live in the injected Elixir
not_applicable.embeddedtemplate: ERB/EJS template layer; all definitions live in the injected Ruby or JavaScript
not_applicable.foam: OpenFOAM dictionary data files; nested keyed sub-dictionaries are configuration values, as in JSON or HOCON
not_applicable.gcode: CNC machine instruction lines (G/M words, coordinates); no named definitions
not_applicable.git_rebase: interactive rebase todo list of commands applied to commit hashes; no declarations
not_applicable.gitattributes: list of path patterns with attributes; patterns select files and declare nothing
not_applicable.gitcommit: commit message text plus git's generated status comments; no declarations
not_applicable.gitignore: list of path patterns to ignore; patterns select files and declare nothing
not_applicable.glimmer: Handlebars/Glimmer templates; components and helpers are declared in the backing JavaScript or TypeScript
not_applicable.godot_resource: editor-serialized scene and resource data; section headers are typed records (ext_resource, sub_resource, node) the editor writes, not author-named blocks
not_applicable.gomod: dependency manifest; module, require and replace lines reference other modules rather than define symbols
not_applicable.gosum: checksum database lines (module, version, hash); generated data
not_applicable.gowork: go.work manifest; use and replace lines reference module directories rather than define symbols
not_applicable.gpg: gpg.conf option lines (keyword plus value); no named blocks or definitions
not_applicable.gstlaunch: a single GStreamer pipeline description of linked elements; no reusable named definitions
not_applicable.haml: HAML markup layer; all definitions live in the injected Ruby
not_applicable.heex: HEEx template layer; function components and assigns are declared in the surrounding Elixir modules
not_applicable.hjson: human JSON data serialization; keys are data, not declarations
not_applicable.hocon: JSON-superset configuration data; nested keyed objects are values, as in JSON
not_applicable.html: document markup; ids are anchors and headings are ordinary elements with mixed inline content, while script and style blocks are injected languages tagged by their own grammars
not_applicable.hurl: sequence of HTTP request/response entries; captures are runtime extractions from responses, not declarations
not_applicable.javadoc: doc-comment markup inside Java comments; the documented symbols are tagged by the Java grammar
not_applicable.jjdescription: Jujutsu change description (commit message) text; no declarations
not_applicable.jsdoc: doc-comment markup inside JavaScript comments; the documented symbols are tagged by the JavaScript grammar
not_applicable.json: data serialization; keys are data, not declarations
not_applicable.json5: JSON5 data serialization; keys are data, not declarations
not_applicable.kdl: KDL document data: a tree of nodes with arguments and properties, not declarations
not_applicable.kitty: kitty.conf option and key-mapping lines; no named blocks or definitions
not_applicable.liquid: Liquid template layer; it has no macros or named blocks, and assign/capture only bind render-time locals
not_applicable.luadoc: doc-comment markup inside Lua comments; the documented symbols are tagged by the Lua grammar
not_applicable.markdown_inline: inline-span layer injected into markdown paragraphs; headings are tagged by the markdown block grammar
not_applicable.mermaid: diagram description; participant, class and state names are drawing data, not program symbols
not_applicable.norg_meta: the key/value metadata block injected into Norg documents; the document's headings are tagged by the norg grammar
not_applicable.pem: base64-encoded key and certificate blocks; data, not source
not_applicable.pgn: chess game records (tag pairs and move lists); data, not source
not_applicable.phpdoc: doc-comment markup inside PHP comments; the documented symbols are tagged by the PHP grammar
not_applicable.plantuml: diagram description; the grammar exposes diagrams as generic command and block nodes with no declaration nodes, and its names are drawing data
not_applicable.po: gettext translation catalog keyed by source text (msgid); entries are translations, not named definitions
not_applicable.poe_filter: Path of Exile loot filter of anonymous Show/Hide condition blocks; nothing is named
not_applicable.promql: a single Prometheus query expression; no declarations
not_applicable.psv: pipe-separated tabular data; rows and fields have no names to index
not_applicable.pymanifest: MANIFEST.in include/exclude directives over file patterns; no declarations
not_applicable.query: tree-sitter query patterns are anonymous; capture names label match results and are not declarations
not_applicable.readline: inputrc key bindings and set-variable lines; no named blocks or definitions
not_applicable.requirements: pip requirement lines that reference packages and version specifiers; no declarations
not_applicable.ron: Rusty Object Notation data serialization; struct names are type tags on values, not declarations
not_applicable.rshtml: RsHtml template layer; logic and definitions live in the injected Rust
not_applicable.rtf: Rich Text Format control words and groups encoding styled text; document data, not source
not_applicable.scfg: generic directive/block config syntax with no notion of a declared name; what a directive means is application-defined
not_applicable.sflog: Salesforce debug log lines; runtime output, not source
not_applicable.slim: Slim markup layer; all definitions live in the injected Ruby
not_applicable.soql: a single Salesforce object query; no declarations
not_applicable.sosl: a single Salesforce search query; no declarations
not_applicable.sparql: RDF query statements; PREFIX lines alias namespaces and query variables are bound per query, not declared
not_applicable.strace: strace system-call trace output; runtime log lines, not source
not_applicable.styled: CSS fragments injected into styled-components template literals; the components are declared and tagged in the host JavaScript or TypeScript
not_applicable.superhtml: HTML document markup (SuperHTML dialect); ids are anchors and headings are inline-content elements, as in html
not_applicable.sxhkdrc: hotkey to command bindings; no named definitions
not_applicable.task: task-list lines (keywords, dates, identifiers) in the tree-sitter-task todo format; no declarations
not_applicable.textproto: protobuf text-format message data; field names refer to the .proto schema, which proto tags
not_applicable.tmux: tmux.conf command lines (set-option, bind-key); no named definitions
not_applicable.todotxt: todo.txt task lines with +project and @context mentions; no declarations
not_applicable.tsv: tab-separated tabular data; rows and fields have no names to index
not_applicable.turtle: RDF triple data; subjects and @prefix aliases are graph data, not program declarations
not_applicable.vhs: linear list of VHS terminal-recording commands (Type, Sleep, Set); no named definitions
not_applicable.vrl: Vector Remap Language event-transform scripts; there are no user-defined functions, and assignments target event fields or short-lived locals
not_applicable.vue: Vue single-file component; its declarations live in the script block (injected JavaScript/TypeScript) and the template declares nothing
not_applicable.xcompose: XCompose key-sequence to character mappings; no named definitions
not_applicable.xit: [x]it! plain-text checklist of task lines grouped under free-text titles; no declarations
not_applicable.xml: markup and data serialization; element names are vocabulary, not declarations (DTDs, which declare elements, are tagged by dtd)
not_applicable.yaml: data serialization; keys are data, and anchors are value aliases rather than declarations
not_applicable.ziggy: Ziggy data documents (a JSON-like serialization); their schema is tagged by ziggy_schema
